header: When the counter and the phones are staffed
text: These are the published hours of the Rebhanggasse office. The breakdown line on 0800 24 24 90 is answered outside them as well, every day of the year.
note: Closed 24 and 31 December, and between Christmas and Epiphany the counter opens on 27 and 30 December from 08:00 to 12:00 only. Holiday changes are announced here two weeks in advance.

rows.title: Friday
rows.text: Counter closes at noon; deliveries until 11:00
